rawResponse.hint: Older bars exist in this window: call get_ohlcv again with date_to=next_date_to (and the same date_from / interval) to get the previous page. A single response holds at most 5000 bars as rows or 8000 as columns (larger results are rejected by the MCP gateway); for long histories use format="columns" and page with date_to, or summary=true for aggregates only.
rawResponse.notice: Market data notice: bars are served under the user's TradingView plan and exchange subscriptions (realtime where the user has the exchange data, otherwise delayed); the last bar is still forming and may change; regular session only; prices are split-adjusted only. For the most recent quote use get_symbol_data (or get_symbol_data_batch) with the "close", "change" and "update_mode" columns.

summary.volume_unit_note: avg_volume / total_volume / last_bar_volume are in BASE units (shares for equities, base tokens for crypto). Do NOT prepend $ to these. last_bar_notional_estimate is approximately the dollar volume of the LAST bar (close × volume), valid only for USD-equivalent quote currencies (USDT/USDC/USD/USX equities).
